statement.ru: Зелёные и чёрные оливки растут на разных деревьях.
statement.en: Green and black olives grow on different trees.

why: Same tree: green olives are picked unripe, black ones at full ripeness.

statement.ru: Ананас понемногу «переваривает» язык того, кто его ест.
statement.en: A pineapple slowly 'digests' the tongue of whoever eats it.

why: Its enzyme bromelain breaks down proteins of the mouth lining, hence the sore tongue.

statement.ru: Попкорн можно сделать из любой кукурузы.
statement.en: You can make popcorn from any kind of corn.

why: Only special popping strains (mainly Zea mays everta) pop; it is one of six corn types.

statement.ru: Начос назвали в честь мексиканца по имени Начо.
statement.en: Nachos are named after a Mexican man called Nacho.

why: Created in 1943 by and named after Ignacio 'Nacho' Anaya in Piedras Negras.

statement.ru: Обжаривание мяса «запечатывает» соки внутри.
statement.en: Searing meat 'seals in' the juices.

why: A myth from Liebig: seared meat actually loses more moisture.

statement.ru: Красный краситель кармин делают из насекомых.
statement.en: The red dye carmine is made from insects.

why: Carmine (E120) is extracted from cochineal insects.

statement.ru: Киви родом из Новой Зеландии.
statement.en: The kiwi fruit comes originally from New Zealand.

why: Native to central and eastern China; New Zealand only grew it commercially from the 1900s.

statement.ru: Сырая красная фасоль ядовита.
statement.en: Raw red kidney beans are poisonous.

why: Uncooked kidney beans hold high levels of the toxic lectin phytohaemagglutinin.

statement.ru: Коричневые яйца полезнее белых.
statement.en: Brown eggs are healthier than white ones.

why: Shell colour depends on the hen's breed; no significant link to nutrition.

statement.ru: «Тирамису» по-итальянски значит «подними меня».
statement.en: 'Tiramisu' means 'pick me up' in Italian.

why: From Italian 'tirami su', 'pick me up' or 'cheer me up'.

statement.ru: Если посолить воду, она закипит гораздо быстрее.
statement.en: Salting water makes it come to the boil much faster.

why: Salt slightly raises the boiling point; at cooking amounts the effect on time is negligible.

statement.ru: Желатин делают из кожи и костей животных.
statement.en: Gelatin is made from animal skin and bones.

why: Gelatin is hydrolysed collagen from skin, bones and connective tissue.

statement.ru: Родина ананаса — Гавайи.
statement.en: The pineapple comes originally from Hawaii.

why: Native to South America; Hawaii only grew and canned it in the 20th century.

statement.ru: Жвачку раньше делали из сока тропического дерева.
statement.en: Chewing gum used to be made from the sap of a tropical tree.

why: Chicle, the latex of the sapodilla tree, was the traditional chewing-gum base.

statement.ru: Бурый и белый рис — это разные растения.
statement.en: Brown rice and white rice come from different plants.

why: White rice is the same grain as brown rice with the bran and germ removed.

statement.ru: В вустерский соус кладут анчоусы.
statement.en: Worcestershire sauce contains anchovies.

why: Anchovies are a main ingredient.

statement.ru: Картофель родом из Ирландии.
statement.en: The potato comes originally from Ireland.

why: Domesticated in southern Peru and north-west Bolivia, in the Andes.

statement.ru: На Сардинии делают сыр с живыми личинками мух.
statement.en: In Sardinia they make a cheese full of live fly maggots.

why: Casu martzu is a Sardinian sheep cheese containing live cheese-fly larvae.

statement.ru: Древние римляне ели помидоры.
statement.en: The ancient Romans ate tomatoes.

why: Tomatoes come from the Americas and reached Europe only after the Spanish conquest (16th century).

statement.ru: Острый перец чили привезли в Индию из Америки.
statement.en: Chilli peppers came to India from the Americas.

why: Chillies are American; Portuguese traders brought them to Asia in the 16th century.

statement.ru: Белая корка на камамбере — это съедобная плесень.
statement.en: The white rind on Camembert is an edible mould.

why: The bloomy, edible rind is grown from Penicillium camemberti mould.

statement.ru: Мармеладных мишек придумали в Германии.
statement.en: Gummy bears were invented in Germany.

why: Hans Riegel of Haribo created the first gummy bears in Bonn in 1922.

statement.ru: Ацтеки ели шоколад плитками.
statement.en: The Aztecs ate chocolate in bars.

why: For the Maya and Aztecs cacao was a drink; solid chocolate came with 19th-century technology.

statement.ru: Капитан Кук брал в плавания квашеную капусту от цинги.
statement.en: Captain Cook took sauerkraut on his voyages against scurvy.

why: Cook took sauerkraut on his sea voyages to prevent scurvy.

statement.ru: Чёрный перец горошком — родственник болгарского перца.
statement.en: Black peppercorns are related to bell peppers.

why: Black pepper is Piper nigrum (Piperaceae); bell and chilli peppers are Capsicum, not closely related.

statement.ru: Кукурузные хлопья придумали для пациентов санатория.
statement.en: Corn flakes were invented for patients at a sanatorium.

why: Created by Will Kellogg in 1894 for patients of the Battle Creek Sanitarium.

statement.ru: Корица — это молотые семена.
statement.en: Cinnamon is ground-up seeds.

why: Cinnamon is the dried inner bark of Cinnamomum trees.

statement.ru: Лобстеры когда-то считались едой бедняков и слуг.
statement.en: Lobster was once seen as food for the poor and for servants.

why: Abundant lobster was a poverty food for servants in coastal New England.

statement.ru: Если птица склюёт сырой рис, она может лопнуть.
statement.en: A bird that eats raw rice can burst.

why: Rice does not make birds explode; the wedding-rice story is a myth.

statement.ru: Первый зефир маршмеллоу делали из корня растения.
statement.en: The first marshmallows were made from a plant root.

why: Made from the root of the marsh-mallow plant (Althaea officinalis).

statement.ru: Арбуз примерно наполовину состоит из воды.
statement.en: A watermelon is about half water.

why: Watermelon is about 91% water.

statement.ru: Чёрную пасту часто красят чернилами каракатицы.
statement.en: Black pasta is often coloured with cuttlefish ink.

why: Cephalopod ink is used as food colouring, for example in pasta.

statement.ru: Рокфор делают из коровьего молока.
statement.en: Roquefort is made from cow's milk.

why: Roquefort is a ewe's (sheep's) milk cheese.

statement.ru: Апельсин — гибрид помело и мандарина.
statement.en: The orange is a hybrid of the pomelo and the mandarin.

why: The sweet orange is the hybrid Citrus × sinensis of pomelo and mandarin.

statement.ru: Белый шоколад делают совсем без какао-бобов.
statement.en: White chocolate is made with nothing from cocoa beans.

why: Its main ingredient is cocoa butter, pressed from cocoa beans.

statement.ru: Дрожжи для теста — это живые грибы.
statement.en: Baker's yeast is a living fungus.

why: Yeasts are single-celled fungi.

statement.ru: Живой омар ярко-красный.
statement.en: A live lobster is bright red.

why: Live lobsters are brownish; cooking breaks down crustacyanin and turns the shell orange-red.

statement.ru: Если съесть очень много моркови, кожа может стать оранжевой.
statement.en: Eat a huge amount of carrots and your skin can turn orange.

why: Excess dietary carotenoids cause carotenosis, an orange skin discolouration.

statement.ru: «Пепперони» по-итальянски значит «колбаса».
statement.en: In Italian, 'pepperoni' means sausage.

why: Italian 'peperoni' means bell peppers; the sausage meaning is American.

statement.ru: Позеленевшая картошка может быть ядовитой.
statement.en: Potatoes that have turned green can be poisonous.

why: Greening shows light exposure, which raises the toxic glycoalkaloid solanine.

statement.ru: Жжение от острого перца лучше всего гасит вода.
statement.en: Water is the best thing to put out the burn of hot peppers.

why: Plain water is ineffective; casein in cold milk works better.

statement.ru: Во Франции рецепт традиционного багета закреплён законом.
statement.en: In France the recipe of the traditional baguette is fixed by law.

why: The traditional baguette's dough is defined by a 1993 French decree.

statement.ru: В Евросоюзе магазинные яйца перед продажей обязательно моют.
statement.en: In the EU, shop eggs must be washed before they are sold.

why: The EU bars washing Class A eggs (a national exception aside); washing harms the protective cuticle. It is the USA that washes eggs.

statement.ru: Кетчуп когда-то продавали как лекарство.
statement.en: Ketchup was once sold as a medicine.

why: In the 1830s tomato ketchup and tomato pills were sold and prescribed as cures for indigestion and diarrhoea.

statement.ru: Красный сок из сырого стейка — это кровь.
statement.en: The red juice from a raw steak is blood.

why: It is water and myoglobin, a muscle protein; blood is drained at slaughter.

statement.ru: Яблоко плавает в воде, потому что в нём много воздуха.
statement.en: An apple floats in water because it holds a lot of air.

why: About a quarter of a fresh apple's volume is air, so it floats.

statement.ru: Если слишком долго взбивать сливки, получится масло.
statement.en: Whip cream for too long and you get butter.

why: Prolonged whipping makes the fat droplets stick together and form butter.

statement.ru: Пятый вкус — умами — открыл японский учёный.
statement.en: The fifth taste, umami, was discovered by a Japanese scientist.

why: Kikunae Ikeda of Tokyo University identified umami in 1908.

statement.ru: Хлеб на закваске поднимается благодаря соде.
statement.en: Sourdough bread rises thanks to baking soda.

why: Sourdough is leavened by wild yeast and lactobacillus bacteria, not soda.

statement.ru: Первые кубики сахара сделали в Чехии.
statement.en: The first sugar cubes were made in what is now Czechia.

why: Jakub Kryštof Rad made the first sugar cubes in Dačice in the early 1840s.
